profile.subtitleJa: マオンというユダの荒野・町の名
profile.summaryJa: サムエル記上23:24では、ダビデとその部下がマオンの荒野にいたと記されます。本文は荒野の範囲を詳しく示しません。

facts.textJa: 23:25でも同じ地名が本文に現れる。
25:2でも同じ地名が本文に現れる。

profile.modernLocationJa: マオン町・荒野の精確な位置は同一視せず、候補比定としてのみ扱います。
profile.historicalRoleJa: ダビデが身を隠した荒野の名。
profile.locationNoteJa: 地図の点は従来資料による未確認の参考候補で、古代の所在を確定するものではありません。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: They arose, and went to Ziph before Saul; but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah on the south of the desert.
Saul and his men went to seek him. When David was told, he went down to the rock, and stayed in the wilderness of Maon. When Saul heard that, he pursued David in the wilderness of Maon.
There was a man in Maon whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great. He had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats; and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.
